architecture: two hidden layers, width32, ReLU; one-hot action; logistic affine per arm
buffer: all real triples; uniform with replacement
environment_pairing: separate context and potential-reward uniform RNGs, seed/family/beta shared across agents/rates/regimes; only chosen reward revealed
failures: preserve config, trace, checkpoint and failure; nonfinite candidate disqualified as a whole in pilot, never drop seeds; any confirmatory failure stops inference and retains incomplete grid
initial_buffer: t1 action0, t2 action1; first update after t2; T-1 total updates
initialization: historical core: hidden normal sqrt(2/fan_in), output sqrt(1/fan_in), zero biases
shared_weights: structured and structured_average share initial values and RNG seeds, never objects or buffers
structured_average: separate structured learner and buffer; mean of its two base propensities for decisions
